And we have the free lane, we just need to make sure that we have a mature engine and rules about which source to use for what so we're conserving the spend.
operator_direction.via: operator to Agent V session brief (ms01-openclaw, ~18:03 ET)

flags._why: SEARCH_ROUTING_ENGINE=1 makes a rerouted caller ask this engine instead of its legacy path. The engine never opens a paid socket unless brave_router's own BRAVE_ROUTER_LIVE arm is also set. SEARCH_ROUTING_DRY_RUN=1 plans every decision and calls nothing.

pricing.evidence: operator brief 2026-10-10 ($5 per 1,000 requests, $5 monthly credit); per_second 50 and per_month limit 0 (= unmetered) from data/runtime/brave_provider_capacity_history.jsonl response headers

budget._caps_basis_why: Every dollar line below is compared to GROSS spend (requests x price) before the $5 monthly credit. That is the conservative reading: the credit only ever makes the billed amount smaller. The spend report shows gross, credit and net billed side by side.

pacing._why: base = working_target / trading days in the month. Unspent pace carries forward by at most one day's base; an overspent pace is repaid from the next day's allowance, never below the floor so a priority scalp is never starved to zero by yesterday.

budget._pools_why: scalp has first claim: background pools (catalyst, other) may spend only their own share of the day and month, so they can never consume the scalp share or the operator reserve; scalp may use any unspent background allowance of the day and may run to the $15 working target; operator questions bypass daily pacing and may run to the $18 local ceiling. Nothing runs past $18.

searxng._why: Measured 2026-10-10 on http://127.0.0.1:18888/config: braveapi (the PAID Brave API, keyed by scripts/install_searxng_config.sh) is enabled in the general category, so every categories=general query through the 'free' lane also spends a Brave request that lib/search_budget never sees. The free lane therefore always names its engines and never names a Brave engine.

alpha_vantage_news._why: Reads the AV owner's rolling 72 h NewsSentimentIndex@v1 store. It never sends an Alpha Vantage request (the owner is the only AV caller and spends the 25/day). Skipped with NOT_GRANTED until providers.alpha_vantage.supplies includes news_sentiment or catalyst_news, and with NO_STORE until the owner writes the index.

financial._why: Brave Goggles re-rank web results toward named hosts. A goggle must be hosted at a public URL; none is hosted yet, so this stays off and no request carries a goggles parameter. Enabling it is a policy edit (url + enabled) after the operator approves hosting the goggle file.

extra_snippets._why: Brave extra_snippets is not verified on the Search plan; no test call was spent to verify it (2026-10-10). Off until verified.

quality._rule: A free answer is SUFFICIENT when every count meets its minimum: results with a URL; results whose host is (a subdomain of) a trusted domain; results that mention the symbol (word match, case-sensitive for tickers) or at least half of the query's key terms in title or snippet; and, when freshness_hours is set, results whose published time is known and within the window. Anything less is INSUFFICIENT and may escalate to the paid tier if the class allows it.

scalp_priority.description: A scalp that is about to fire (scripts/lib/scalp_priority.py classifier): research the catalyst now.

catalyst_confirmation.description: Catalyst check for a scalp or momentum name that is NOT about to fire, and the catalyst_news search backup.

operator.description: A question the operator asked and is waiting for (web_research, intel_query, manual).

gap_fill.description: Data-gap residual web search (gap_resolver). Free only: a gap is a background question.

quality_escalation.description: A thin research answer climbing one rung (research_quality_escalate). Free only.

social_discovery.description: Aegis social mention discovery (aegis_social_sentiment, only when AEGIS_BRAVE_ENABLED=1). Free only.

transcript_discovery.description: Aegis transcript / commentary discovery (aegis_transcript_discovery, only when AEGIS_BRAVE_ENABLED=1). Free only.

_callers_why: A caller names itself; the policy names its class. A caller with a symbol that the scalp-priority classifier marks about-to-fire is promoted to scalp_priority (promotable_to_priority below). A caller absent from this map is refused UNKNOWN_CALLER - no default class, so a new caller cannot spend by accident.

scalp._why: About to fire = on the current scalp list (projection no older than 15 min, or a candidate the calling lane hands in), inside premarket or RTH on an NYSE trading day, not AVOID, and either within 5 points of the GO line (score >= go_min - 5) or showing momentum (RVOL >= 3 with a gap >= 5% or a move >= 10%), and not researched in the last 30 minutes. The top 5 by score per cycle.
